d: Some wild animals seem determined to turn every rescue into a full-blown showdown! When unusual creatures cause chaos, Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and Neal James step in to handle the trouble. Across a series of unpredictable wildlife rescue missions, they face stubborn intruders, difficult animal captures and creatures that refuse to cooperate. From snake rescue and turtle catching to raccoon and mink removal, each assignment calls for a different approach.
